$comment: Companion template from The Last Mile. Modify freely and use at work, no attribution needed. Minimum field list for a full-chain trace (Template 16.1 observability). A trace is not the decision trail: a trace answers 'why does this suggestion look the way it does' (engineering replay), the decision trail answers 'who decided what' (an audit commitment, see templates/action-queue/schema.sql). You need both. The field structure lines up with the decision trail's six fields (basis / what was said / when), and human decisions plus the decider go into the decision trail table only, never into the trace.
title: trace-record

claim_id.description: claim number, matches the source system's primary key, can be looked up

input_snapshot.description: input snapshot / fingerprint reference (lines up with the decision trail: basis)

retrieved_content.description: list of references to retrieved content (fingerprints of the retrieved snippets that went into the prompt)

prompt_version.description: prompt version (lines up with the decision trail: basis)

rule_hits.description: rules hit and their version (e.g. 'repair shop list rule v12')

final_display.description: the exact suggestion and reasoning finally shown to the person handling it (lines up with the decision trail: what was said)

created_at.description: generation timestamp, ISO 8601 (lines up with the decision trail: when)
